title: Baa Juice Raspberry Watermelon 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Baa Juice Nic Salt Raspberry Watermelon blends the tangy sweetness of ripe Raspberry with the light, refreshing taste of Watermelon. This balanced yet deliciously vibrant flavour delivers a smooth and satisfying vape, ideal for fans of fruity blends with a light and refreshing finish. As part of the Baa Juice Bar Salts collection, this nicotine salt e-liquid is crafted with a double-concentrated flavour profile designed to replicate the intense taste found in single-use disposable vape bars. With a 50VG/50PG ratio, it’s perfect for Mouth-To-Lung (MTL) pod kits and starter devices, offering smooth throat hits and rapid nicotine satisfaction. Available in 5mg, 10mg, and 20mg nicotine strengths, Raspberry Watermelon provides a versatile and economical alternative to single-use disposables, ideal for use with refillable vape devices.
